spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/acr-vla-conformal-refinement && python -u src/evaluate.py --mode reconvla --K 10 --benchmark long --seed 42 --n_rollouts 20"

experiment_data.hypothesis: Reconvla K=10 argmin on LIBERO-Long seed42. Tests if reconstruction-based action selection benefits long-horizon tasks. Reconvla achieved 80% on Spatial (vs 78.5% VLA-only) and 79% on Object (vs 77.8% VLA-only).
